content: 1. Within the past four years, have you or your research unit received any financial or non-financial support from a commercial entity or organization with an interest related to the subject of the meeting or work? This includes grants, collaborations, sponsorships, or other funding. 2. Have you received non-monetary support valued at more than USD $1,000 in total, such as equipment, facilities, research assistants, or paid travel to meetings? 3. Have you received honoraria or other forms of compensation for being part of a speakers' bureau, delivering speeches, or conducting training for a commercial entity or organization with an interest related to the subject of the meeting or work? 4. Do you currently hold investments valued at more than USD $5,000 in a commercial entity with an interest related to the subject of the meeting or work? This includes indirect investments such as trusts or holding companies but excludes broadly diversified mutual funds or pension funds over which you have no control. 5. Do you have intellectual property rights, such as patents, trademarks, or copyrights (including pending applications), that may be affected positively or negatively by the outcome of the meeting or work? 6. Do you possess proprietary know-how in a substance, technology, or process that may be influenced by the meeting or work? 7. In the past three years, have you provided expert opinions or testimony as part of a regulatory, legislative, or judicial process related to the subject of the meeting or work for a commercial entity or organization? 8. Have you held a position, paid or unpaid, where you represented the interests of or defended a position related to the subject of the meeting or work? 9. If not already disclosed, have you worked for a competitor of a product that is the subject of the meeting or work, or will your participation in the meeting or work provide you access to a competitor's confidential proprietary information or create a competitive advantage for you personally, professionally, financially, or in business? 10. To your knowledge, would the outcome of the meeting or work benefit or adversely affect the interests of others with whom you have substantial common personal, professional, financial, or business interests (e.g., adult children, siblings, close professional colleagues, or administrative units)? 11. Excluding the WHO, has any person or entity paid or contributed to your travel costs in connection with this WHO meeting or work? 12. Have you received any payments (other than for travel costs) or honoraria for speaking publicly on the subject of this WHO meeting or work? 13. Is there any other aspect of your background or current circumstances not addressed above that might be perceived as affecting your objectivity or independence? 14. Within the past four years, have you had employment, received research support or other funding, or had any professional relationship with an entity directly involved in the production, manufacture, distribution, or sale of tobacco or tobacco products, or that represents the interests of such an entity? For any Yes responses, please provide a detailed explanation of the circumstances, including the name of the company, organization, or institution, whether the interest belongs to you, a family member, employer, or research unit, and the amount or value of the interest. If the nature of the interest or its value is not disclosed, it will be assumed to be significant. By completing and signing this form, you consent to the disclosure of any relevant conflicts to other meeting participants and in the resulting report or work product. You also declare that the disclosed information is true and complete to the best of your knowledge and agree to promptly notify the responsible WHO staff of any changes to the information provided, including changes occurring before or during the meeting or work, and up to the publication of the final results or completion of the activity.
